spiritual_reading:
When the good that engages directly with evil went out to oppose the assault, it invested itself with the outward truth that carries the full force of love. By that invested state it dried up and subdued the swelling self-exaltation of the opposing force, and it cast down the enemy’s empty persuasions and vainglorious pretensions.

That single invested power was enough for those who depended on it; yet because the primary force of love in outermost action had been weakened through combat, it therefore added a sufficient support in fullness by surrounding that love with additional exterior forms of operation: one that gave it active impulsion, one that gave it ordered discernment through truth, one that gave it clear intelligence, and one that gave it a stable ultimate plane for action. These were given so that they might serve as helpers to the primary governing love, so that what is hostile could not enter into that love in its outward working and pierce it, and so that destructive falsity and enmity could not sever its connection.

Although the governing love in its external operation suffered assault and felt injury in its embodied form, still through it the whole array of falsities was pressed and constrained. And because the conflict required conjunction and cooperation, it was also necessary that the supporting powers, as companions in that work, should undergo assault and felt injury as well, for the enemy’s influence entered and mingled with them—except for the ultimate plane of action itself. Into that ultimate plane the falsity did not mingle, and the heated rage of the enemy was not able to pass into it.

Nevertheless even that power which remained without injury—the ultimate plane of action—divested itself of its own external investment and operative strength, and transferred it to its four companions in its stead, so that by means of that strengthened ultimate support they might be made firm, become effective for use, and endure in their functions, namely the other four supporting powers. And that ultimate support became for them a continuing vitality in their labor.

fills.notes: Standard oldest-layer cosmological title: the primal championing hypostasis that goes out to meet Darkness.
Completes ene[my ...] → enemy; the ellipsis belongs to the following lacuna.

The spiritual sense requires an act of investiture: the First Man ‘invests’ himself with the garment that is living fire (outer truth bearing love’s force). The clause must introduce the direct object ‘the darkness with the garment…’ as the opponent being met and constrained in that invested state.
Matches the fixed phrase ‘garment of living fire’.
Restores the support-by-fullness motif: four additional ‘garments’ as exterior operative forms surrounding the weakened living fire.
Completes ‘which is’ for identifying the governing element as living fire.
The correspondential logic demands a prevention-of-influx clause: hostile falsity must be kept from entering the living fire in its outward operation.

Spiritual sense: although wounded, the governing love in ultimates still ‘pressed and constrained’ the array of falsities. This supplies the needed adversative continuation before ‘all the powers of darkness’.
Completes the effect: ‘all the powers of darkness’ are held in check ‘because of it’ (because of the fire’s invested combat).
Bridges to the necessity statement: the conflict required conjunction and thus ‘it was also a necessity…’.

fills.notes: The oldest-layer structure is the fivefold set (fire plus four garments). The spiritual translation explicitly speaks of companions in cooperation, leading into ‘necessity… brothers…’.
The exempt element is the ultimate plane that does not admit mixture; matches the spiritual sense ‘except for the ultimate plane of action itself’.

Spiritual sense requires an efficacy-for-use clause: strengthened by the living air, the four injured powers become effective (profit) and enduring. This fill supplies the needed verbal idea before ‘profit, and endure’.
Matches the closing idea: the living air becomes for them a continuing vitality (remaining life) in their labor.

assessment: Most lacunae are single-letter or fixed formulae and restore strongly. The larger gaps are constrained primarily by the correspondential sequence: (1) investiture for combat, (2) fourfold supportive garments as exterior operations around living fire, (3) prevention of hostile influx, (4) necessity of shared wounding among the five except the ultimate plane (air), and (5) air’s transfer of its garment as enduring support and continuing life. Exact idiom in the larger gaps remains moderately uncertain, but the required spiritual functions are tight.
